full_details: At nine the pass was the queen's entrance. Kemp was not on the plot. You kept the king out of the garden, and you did not put a fool in to keep the peace. Sixteen days stand between this morning and the yard. Nick took two paces toward the shadow. Phillips was in the house for his own roll, and Verona was not in anyone's mouth. In the afternoon the leaf still had the man in the square, with no speech, and you wrote that her house had not heard. At a quarter to five you were in the tiring-house. The paint of Titus was still red on three of the hired men. Kettleby called from Somerset House, back from Nonsuch since Sunday. The sense was play on. No letter had gone out to any justice. If a justice of Middlesex comes, the man is to be sent on. Heminges told you to ask if that was in writing. Nothing my lord says is in writing. Heminges wrote the two words in the company book and looked at them. At home you called it a compliment to a hand, and not a licence.
one_sentence: You gave the entrance to Nick and the hedge to Pope, and took my lord's answer as play on.
title: Gave Nick the entrance and heard play on
